summary: Skier killed in a sidecountry avalanche near Aspen Mountain (Peter Barker path / Castle Creek Valley); a second skier was caught but uninjured and alerted rescuers; Mountain Rescue Aspen recovered the body the following day.
notes: Reported in avalanche-center 2014-15 season index Victim count corrected 2026-09-12 (was 2): the CAIC classic table, the avalanche-center 2014-15 season index, Unofficial Networks (two skiers caught, one killed) and CPR (one dead skier; a five-person Mountain Rescue Aspen team recovered the body the next day) all report ONE killed. CPR 2015-02-24 corroboration added run 684: body found Monday, recovered Tuesday by 5-person MRA team.
